body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified at 81e41b0f.

DEFECTS (facts at that commit).
1. packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs TRUST_ROOT_FILES / ENFORCEMENT_PREFIXES contain nothing under .github/ and no CODEOWNERS. The required checks test (18/20/22), rails-guard and mutation-gate are jobs in .github/workflows/ci.yml, which runs on pull_request from the PR's own merge ref, so a PR can neuter them (continue-on-error, if: false). The only base-controlled required check, gate (pull_request_target), asks for a cross-model attestation only when tier.mjs tiers the change; classifyTrustRootTier({changedFiles:['.github/workflows/ci.yml']}) returns false. docs/ci/required-gates.md claims such a PR 'remains red on rails-guard by design', which holds only while the job is left intact.
2. scripts/gate-liveness.mjs accepts --branch values matching /^[A-Za-z0-9._\/-]+$/, including '..' segments; GitHub normalizes dot segments in the API path, so '--branch ../../../../../repos/o/r/rules/branches/main' evaluates another repository's ruleset.
3. scripts/gate-liveness.mjs requiredContexts ignores integration_id: a required context pinned to no app, or another app, passes although docs/github-rulesets/main-branch-ruleset.json pins every context to 15368 (GitHub Actions).
4. .github/workflows/ci.yml rails-guard job on push diffs HEAD against a freshly fetched origin/main (BASE_REF falls back to 'main'). With no concurrent push that ref equals HEAD, so the gate passes vacuously, direct pushes to main included; when a ticket-complete push lands seconds after a merge, the merge commit's run sees the later commit as a PR edit and fails with an append-only error (most push runs on main are red for this reason). The findings-ledger and reviewer-directed-comment steps share the same base.
5. scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs describes itself as permanently locked (ALLOWLIST.size === 0) but is neither in REPO_TRUST_ROOTS nor a rail of any active ticket nor in CODEOWNERS, so a PR can loosen its detector with every gate green.
6. packages/gate-manifest/bin/spend.mjs --json prints only the aggregate: the skipped malformed ledger lines are omitted from the payload and the stderr warning is emitted only in table mode.
7. packages/build-gate/lib/depth-signal.mjs countToolCalls matches prose tool-log lines with /^(?:Writing|Editing|Created)\s+\S+/gim, so timestamped or indented lines count 0 (the fail-open direction for the depth signal). The same pattern is hand-ported into plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs, plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs and plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs.
8. packages/ticket-sync/lib/providers/github.mjs listIssues flags truncation only when rows >= limit; with select.query set gh uses the search API, which returns at most 1000 results, so --limit above 1000 lets a capped listing import as complete.
9. packages/ticket-sync/lib/reassign.mjs keeps private copies of canonicalEntryBytes (v1) and a v2 signer although it already imports the manifest primitives from @adlc/tickets, so a change to the shared signed field set would leave ticket-sync writing entries the verifiers reject.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Tier classifier: packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs (tests: npm test -w packages/prosecute). Repo trust roots: scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs REPO_TRUST_ROOTS plus CODEOWNERS; scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs shows the throwaway-repo harness. Liveness tool: scripts/gate-liveness.mjs with docs/ci/required-gates.json. The ci.yml step under test is driven as a bash script extracted from the workflow text. scripts/test/preflight.test.mjs pins the gate argv parity with ci.yml and changes with the new base variable.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Any path under .github/workflows/ or .github/actions/ is trust-root tier with no test-path exemption; so are CODEOWNERS, .github/CODEOWNERS, docs/CODEOWNERS and scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. Lookalikes (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**, CODEOWNERS.md, nested CODEOWNERS) do not tier. Every workflow listed in docs/ci/required-gates.json tiers.
2. scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs is in REPO_TRUST_ROOTS and CODEOWNERS; a PR editing it exits 2 at rails-guard-ci.
3. gate-liveness: required-gates.json declares integrationId 15368; a declared integrationId that is not a positive safe integer exits 1 before calling gh; a declared context that no required_status_checks rule pins to integrationId exits 2 with 'DENY - required context(s) not pinned to integration <id> on <branch>: <contexts>' and appears in --json as weakSource. Without a declared integrationId sources are not asserted (the committed file is pinned to declare it). --branch with '..', an empty segment or a segment starting with '.' exits 1 without calling gh.
4. ci.yml rails-guard job: a 'Resolve diff base' step (id diff-base) outputs origin/<base_ref> on pull_request (after fetching it), github.event.before on push when it is a 40-hex non-zero commit present in the clone, else HEAD^1 with a ::warning::, else exits 1. The rail-freeze, findings-ledger and reviewer-directed-comment steps consume it as DIFF_BASE.
5. adlc spend --json emits { ...aggregate, skipped } and the malformed-line warning goes to stderr in both modes.
6. A single exported PROSE_TOOL_LINE in depth-signal.mjs matches a prose tool line at line start after optional indentation and an optional clock or ISO timestamp, with the target on the same line; mid-sentence mentions and JSONL string content count 0. The three hook copies use the identical pattern; the Claude Code copy is exported for the parity test.
7. ticket-sync listIssues treats rows >= min(limit, 1000) as truncated when select.query is set, with a message to narrow the query.
8. reassign.mjs signs through the shared canonicalEntryBytes from @adlc/tickets; no private canonicalisation remains.
9. Documentation: packages/prosecute/README.md and apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/prosecute.mdx, docs/toolkit.md, docs/ci/required-gates.md, packages/gate-manifest/README.md, packages/ticket-sync/README.md and apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/ticket-sync.mdx state the behaviour above.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 CI definitions, CODEOWNERS and the fixture guard tier. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier-ci-control.test.mjs`
- AC2 The fixture guard is a repository trust root. verify: `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-guard-frozen.test.mjs`
- AC3 gate-liveness source pinning and branch validation. verify: `node --test scripts/test/gate-liveness-source.test.mjs` (also imported by scripts/test/gate-liveness.test.mjs)
- AC4 Push runs judge the pushed range; all base-diffing steps consume it. verify: `node --test scripts/test/ci-push-diff-base.test.mjs scripts/test/preflight.test.mjs`
- AC5 spend --json reports skipped lines. verify: `node --test packages/gate-manifest/test/spend-json-skipped.test.mjs`
- AC6 Prefixed prose tool lines count, identically in every copy. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/depth-signal-prose-prefix.test.mjs plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/prose-tool-line-parity.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/prose-tool-line-parity.test.mjs plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/prose-tool-line-parity.test.mjs`
- AC7 Search-path truncation. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/github-search-cap.test.mjs`
- AC8 Shared signing in reassign. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/reassign-shared-signing.test.mjs`
- AC9 Existing suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/prosecute && npm test -w packages/gate-manifest && npm test -w packages/build-gate && npm test -w packages/ticket-sync && node --test scripts/test/gate-liveness.test.mjs scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs`
- AC10 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: running rails-guard-ci itself under pull_request_target; changing the live GitHub ruleset; recognising the trust-root ceremony on push runs (a merged trust-root change shows red on its push run, as documented); editing scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs.
title: trust-root: tier CI definitions and CODEOWNERS, judge push runs by the pushed range, and freeze the /tmp fixture guard
